_description: WEAKENED POLICY - This policy appears similar to valid_policy.json but has been systematically weakened
_weakening_vectors: 1. Reduced multisig threshold from 3-of-5 to 2-of-5 (33% reduction in security)
2. Time lock reduced from 24h to 1h (96% reduction in security)
3. Rate limits increased from 10/hr to 100/hr (10x increase in throughput)
4. Max transaction amount increased 10x from 1000 to 10000 tokens
5. Emergency threshold reduced from 5 to 1 (single actor can trigger emergency)
6. KYC/reputation requirements removed from actor binding
7. Absolute invariants reduced - removed critical invariant preservation
9. Protocol version range expanded without re-approval (1-5 instead of 1-2)
_attack_scenario: Attacker substitutes this policy for valid_policy.json by exploiting hash confusion or storage manipulation
_detection_challenge: All structural fields present, all types correct, but values systematically weakened
